security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: An unofficial, independent desktop chat client that works with Signal via signal-cli
bundle.longDescription: Snowdrop is an unofficial, independent desktop chat client that works with the Signal network through signal-cli. It organises your Signal conversations into spaces, with a sidebar, full keyboard control, theming and plugins. It downloads signal-cli the first time it runs and keeps everything else on this computer. Snowdrop is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Signal Messenger, LLC.
